text.paragraph: Eight-week review: blood pressure, lipids, kidney function, semaglutide and the endoscopy result. [S]

Mr. Frazier returns six weeks after the consultation. He took semaglutide 0.25 mg weekly for four weeks and has taken 0.5 mg for two weeks; he had mild nausea for two days after each step and none now, and no abdominal pain. His appetite is smaller and he has lost 1.8 kg. He takes amlodipine 5 mg; home readings average 136/84. He has had no alcohol. The upper endoscopy last week showed no varices. He attended the first diabetes class. His eye appointment is next month. [S]
